notes.title: Are you RELOAD ?
notes.content:
Friends, I sent a removal request to the Steam administration. While Steam is thinking, you have the last chance to contact me for the key for the TECHNOSPHERE RELOAD. After deleting the keys will not be distributed.

notes.title: RELOAD
notes.content:
Hello friends!
It is time to announce great news.
May 15, we release our game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1054090/TECHNOSPHERE_RELOAD/]TECHNOSPHERE RELOAD[/url]
Add the game to your wish list!

Anyone who has already bought the “Technosphere” will receive free keys.
In order to get a free key, mail me your Steam ID to [u]adaptivegame.games@gmail.com[/u].
Requests for keys will be accepted until April 15.
After that, the “TECHNOSHERE” will be removed from Steam.
Anyone who does not send a request for a key before April 15 will [u]not[/u] be able to receive a free key. Please understand our position.

notes.title: Bad and good news
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31084933/d0322ad71e47fd4e7e2fc8580d95cfd12bd9a5af.png[/img]

I have bad and good news.
Let's start with the [b][u]bad[/u][/b] - the publisher with whom I started, stole 30,000 keys. Steam did not want to take part in the dispute, so I decided to publish the game under a new name and under a new id. This was the reason that I had to shift the release date.
[b][u]The good news[/u][/b] is that the game will be released before the end of spring 2019. Anyone who has bought the "TECHNOSPHERE" will receive free keys to the new game.
I will inform details later.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31084933/d3e290d2f6c31dc31dd6098d222b852e2486f535.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Comming soon
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31084933/d0322ad71e47fd4e7e2fc8580d95cfd12bd9a5af.png[/img]

The development of the game is very active.
We plan to finish by the end of summer.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31084933/d1689a646c923c85606a23de217295239ea6b1b8.jpg[/img]

The game will have 10 levels united by history.
At the moment, we begin to design levels and explore the game world.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31084933/9ef32d78121416dd7f6570fc6a299a6c412dc42d.jpg[/img]

Sometimes it will be scary, sometimes hot, but you should not give up. You must save humanity.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31084933/62b7dce61f63d7f32a73d73aada05cd105f713af.jpg[/img]

Tell your friends about the game. Support the development that the game would be the best quality.

notes.title: Update 0.3.1

notes.content:
We are pleased to present an update to 0.3.0.
Starting with this version, we add a story mode.
We are still thinking about what to do with the levels that were in the old build.
We consider several options:

a) add a system of achievements and run the competition.
b) use as the basis for future levels of play.
c) leave as is, in memory of how it all began.
e) close access to the level and open only to those who will pass the final version of the game.
e) delete the old levels.

Tell us your opinion. It is very important.

Also, we are pleased to announce that we have added some improvements to the game:
- 16K textures (4096x4096).
- Dynamic HQ-Shadows.
- Ambient Occlusion.
- TXAA.
- Bokeh DOF.
- Based on Unreal Engine 4.18.2.

The next stage of the development will focus on adding new mechanics, score system and improve gaming experience.

notes.title: Update 0.2.5
notes.content:
We are proud to announce that we are publishers on Steam.
This means that we can be closer to the fans and make the game better.
We updated the game to version 0.2.5 and prepare version 0.3.0 in the coming days.
Version 0.2.5 changes.
- New textures.
- Optimized program code.
- Improved optimization.
- levels Correction.

Version 0.3.0 will include the Story mode and will appear soon.
Thank you for your support and participation in the creation of the game.
Tell your friends about our game. Together we can do more ːsteamhappyː
